CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `companyManagers` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `companyId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `processOwnerInvitations` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `companyId` int NOT NULL,
  `processId` int NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `accessCode` varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  `invitationToken` varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `status` enum('pending', 'accepted', 'expired') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `expiresAt` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `acceptedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `processOwners` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `companyId` int NOT NULL,
  `processId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `accessCode` varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);

SELECT 'Tables created successfully' as status;
